description: This Java source file implements a command strategy for approving loans within the Apache Fineract batch processing system. It defines the ApproveLoanCommandStrategy class, which interacts with the LoansApiResource to approve a loan by its ID, handling HTTP responses and errors accordingly.

classes.name: ApproveLoanCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to approve a loan based on batch request input. It extracts the loan ID from the request URL, calls the LoansApiResource to approve, and constructs a BatchResponse with the outcome.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the approval process of a loan within a batch request. Extracts loan ID from URL, calls the API resource to approve, and returns a BatchResponse with the status and body.
